name: Click Indicator
description: A handcam replacement: shows your own images while you click or hold. Works with macros and bots.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Show the click indicator in levels.

show-in.name: Show in
show-in.description: Which kinds of levels show the indicator.

hide-idle.name: Only show while clicking
hide-idle.description: Hide the idle image completely, so the indicator only appears while you click or hold.

t-images.name: Images
t-images.description: Leave the image pickers empty to use the built-in skin.

skin.name: Built-in skin
skin.description: Which built-in pictures to use when you haven't picked your own.

idle-image.name: Idle image
idle-image.description: Shown while you are NOT clicking. PNG recommended (transparent edges are cropped automatically).

pressed-image.name: Clicking image
pressed-image.description: Shown while you ARE clicking or holding.

hold-image.name: Long-hold image (optional)
hold-image.description: If set, this replaces the clicking image once you've held for the 'Long-hold after' time. Leave empty to disable.

trim.name: Crop transparent edges
trim.description: Ignore empty transparent space around PNG images, so the picture sits exactly where you put it.

position.name: Position
position.description: Where on the screen the indicator sits.

size.name: Size
size.description: Height of the image as a percentage of the screen height.

margin-x.name: Horizontal margin
margin-x.description: Distance from the left/right edge (percent of screen height). Negative values push it off the edge. When centred, this nudges it right.

margin-y.name: Vertical margin
margin-y.description: Distance from the top/bottom edge (percent of screen height). Negative values push it off the edge. When centred, this nudges it up.

pressed-rotation.name: Extra rotation while clicking
pressed-rotation.description: Extra tilt, in degrees, added while you click.

pressed-scale.name: Clicking image size
pressed-scale.description: Makes the clicking image bigger or smaller than the idle one (1.0 = same size).

idle-opacity.name: Idle opacity
idle-opacity.description: How visible the idle image is, in percent.

pressed-opacity.name: Clicking opacity
pressed-opacity.description: How visible the clicking image is, in percent.

idle-tint.name: Idle tint
idle-tint.description: Colours the idle image. White = no change.

pressed-tint.name: Clicking tint
pressed-tint.description: Colours the clicking image. White = no change.

backdrop.name: Backdrop
backdrop.description: Draw a coloured box behind the indicator so it's easy to see on any background.

backdrop-opacity.name: Backdrop opacity
backdrop-opacity.description: How solid the backdrop is, in percent.

backdrop-padding.name: Backdrop padding
backdrop-padding.description: Extra space around the image inside the backdrop (percent of screen height).

t-timing.name: Timing
t-timing.description: Make clicks easier to see, or line them up with your recording.

min-click-time.name: Minimum click time (ms)
min-click-time.description: Keeps the clicking image up for at least this long, so very fast taps can still be seen.

press-delay.name: Press delay (ms)
press-delay.description: Waits this long before showing the clicking image. Use it to line up with a video that lags behind the game.

release-delay.name: Release delay (ms)
release-delay.description: Keeps the clicking image up this long after you let go.

fade-time.name: Fade time (ms)
fade-time.description: How long the swap between images takes. 0 = instant.

hold-threshold.name: Long-hold after (ms)
hold-threshold.description: How long you must hold before the long-hold image appears (only if you picked one).

idle-timeout.name: Hide idle image after (seconds)
idle-timeout.description: Fade the idle image out after this many seconds without clicking. 0 = never.

pop.name: Click pop (%)
pop.description: The clicking image briefly swells by this much when you click. 0 = off.

ripple.name: Click ripple
ripple.description: A ring expands and fades out every time you click.

ripple-size.name: Ripple size (%)
ripple-size.description: How big the ripple ring grows, relative to the indicator.

ripple-opacity.name: Ripple opacity
ripple-opacity.description: How visible the ripple starts out, in percent.

track.name: Track
track.description: Which player's clicks to show in 2-player / dual levels.

platformer-buttons.name: Left/right count as clicking
platformer-buttons.description: In PLATFORMER levels only, also treat holding left or right as clicking. Never applies in classic levels.

separate-p2.name: Separate Player 2 indicator
separate-p2.description: Show a second indicator that follows only Player 2 (the main one then follows only Player 1).

p2-idle-image.name: Player 2 idle image
p2-idle-image.description: Optional. Falls back to the normal idle image.

p2-pressed-image.name: Player 2 clicking image
p2-pressed-image.description: Optional. Falls back to the normal clicking image.
